task.title: Fix SHA-256 local-bare sync after repository packing
task.description:
The 2026-07-29 repository acceptance run exposed an object-format-specific sync failure. At 500 tasks by 20 operations after projection measurements, git pack-refs --all, and git gc, SHA-256 workbook sync --json to an empty local bare origin exited operational with: Git returned 0 push outcomes, want 500. The equivalent SHA-1 repository scenario completed in 874.16 ms with 15 Git processes, and the isolated SHA-256 initial-publication topology completed in 1,034.34 ms with 14 processes.

Add a focused real-repository reproducer for the packed/gc topology, capture Git porcelain and Trace2 evidence, and determine whether the mismatch comes from ref discovery, refspec construction, Git output parsing, or harness sequencing. Fix the source rather than relaxing the expected 500 outcomes. Preserve hash-algorithm independence, packed-ref support, per-ref results, non-force publication, and error precedence.

Acceptance: initial and unchanged local-bare sync complete after pack-refs and gc in both SHA-1 and SHA-256 repositories; exact pushed/ref invariants are verified; the original 0-outcome mutation fails before the fix; and existing remote topology/process-shape tests remain green.
